text: {"lessons":["Selling Stock A, C, and D at gains felt rewarding, but I should not sell just to lock in a profit; I should consider each stock’s role and my overall allocation.","Buying Stock A and C again after selling them shows how focusing on my past sale price can pull me into unnecessary trades. I should decide from current information, not to validate or undo an earlier choice.","My account value moved up and down without a predictable pattern, and I rarely trade. I should stay patient, avoid reacting to short-term fluctuations, and trade only when there is a clear reason."]}
